Small thing, big difference: every page is single-sided.

Because a 4-year-old with a texta does not do "lightly". Blank backs mean markers never bleed through to the next picture — in the paperback and in the printable.

Printing tips for the PDF:
• Plain copy paper for pencils and crayons
• 120gsm+ or light card for textas
• Printer set to "Fit to page"
• Print as many copies as you like — siblings, classrooms, the cousins at Christmas lunch

Bold, satisfying linework. Medium detail — an evening's worth, never fiddly.
